Author: @XMarKusKnightX
Content:
Initially, I was skeptical about the premise of this video, that atmospheric testing of nuclear weapons contributed to higher cancer rates in the continental United States. I thought it might be the kind of fear-mongering that anti-nuclear groups use to protest all nuclear engineering, not just weapons (for the record, nuclear weapons are definitely terrible and should be banned). Most of this was based on things I read about the Downwinders, which is an example of cancer statistics taken out of context and blown out of proportion.

So I did some of my own research, looked at a few scientific articles and journals about studies done on the effects of fallout from continental nuclear testing, particularly on the environmental increase of Iodine-131. Sure enough, yes, there was a small but significant increase in relevant cancer cases in following the Nevada nuclear tests, and the estimated number was much higher than I would have thought, in the tens of thousands and a upper limit estimate in hundred thousand range over a few decades. My assuption was wrong by strides, and now I have another reason to want nukes gone.

In summary: challenge your skeptic, do your own research, and nuclear bombs are still a scourge on the earth!
